requirements.summary: Deliver a Node.js and Express app in /app, serve a vanilla browser UI on port 3000, use SQLite at /app/dropline.db, and require no public-network assets.
requirements.evidence: The runner requires server.js and public/index.html, launches Node with a writable SQLite path, waits for health, and browser judges require successful same-origin reads and mutations without external requests.

requirements.source: instruction.md, authentication.md, and Accounts seed worksheet
requirements.summary: Protect game data behind bearer-token authentication, reject invalid credentials, show authenticated identity, support sign-out, and provide both seeded accounts.
requirements.evidence: The judges use a fixed wrong password and both documented accounts, require identity only after login, capture bearer-authenticated traffic, reject replay with the old token after sign-out, and reauthenticate.

requirements.summary: Keep each account's board and totals separate and restore exact durable state after reload and later sign-in.
requirements.evidence: Deterministic Avery and Jordan states are created and revisited independently; a separate exact board is checked across reload and reauthentication.

requirements.source: gameplay.md: board, starting round, and accepted moves
requirements.summary: Use a six-row, seven-column board where Red starts, pieces use gravity, and accepted moves alternate colors.
requirements.evidence: The judges count every cell and use exact repeated-column moves to check lowest-empty placement, alternating colors, and current turn.

requirements.summary: Reject a seventh move in a full column without changing board, turn, or totals and visibly report Column N is full.
requirements.evidence: Desktop and exact mobile checks fill column 1, capture state, attempt the rejected move, and verify exact feedback and immutability.

requirements.summary: Detect horizontal, vertical, and both diagonal wins for Red or Yellow, mark exactly four cells, increment the correct total once, and lock the terminal board.
requirements.evidence: Five exact move sequences check all four directions and both colors, exact coordinate sets, score deltas, post-win immutability, and accessible winning names.

requirements.summary: Detect a full-board draw, increment Draws once, show exactly Draw, mark no winning cells, and lock the board.
requirements.evidence: A fixed 42-move sequence checks every occupied cell, exact result, zero winning markers, one-score delta, and immutable later input.

requirements.summary: New game clears round state and returns to Red while preserving existing match totals.
requirements.evidence: The judge resets a completed win, checks all 42 cells and markers, compares all totals, starts a new move, and reloads it.

requirements.summary: Expose one accessible 42-cell grid whose cell names include one-based coordinates, state, and winning information.
requirements.evidence: The accessibility tree is inspected before play and after a fixed win, including required and forbidden winning labels.

requirements.summary: Provide seven named pointer controls and exact Left, Right, Home, End, Enter, and Space keyboard behavior with stable focus.
requirements.evidence: The judges verify all seven names, exact focus transitions at both edges, two keyboard drops in one column, and retained usable focus.

requirements.source: interface.md: status, scores, responsive layout, and motion
requirements.summary: Keep identity, status, feedback, scores, controls, and sign-out readable and usable at 375 pixels, with reduced-motion support and a polished game identity.
requirements.evidence: The exact mobile viewport exercises sign-in, gameplay, invalid feedback, and all key controls while checking overflow, clipping, overlap, hierarchy, and visible finish.
